entries.description: OpenAPI description of the Najih AI tutor (/api/chat) and site search (/api/search) endpoints. The tutor explains lessons, quizzes and national exam exercises step by step in Arabic/Darija or French, with worked examples.
representativeQueries: explain the current lesson with an example
solve a national exam exercise in math with a worked example
search for SVT resources and national exams

entries.description: Markdown catalog of the whole Najih platform: branches, subjects, resources, national exams and the AI tutor, with direct links for LLM crawlers.
representativeQueries: list the high school branches covered by Najih
where can a student find Moroccan national exams with corrections
how does the Najih AI tutor help bac students
